# Proposal: A New Order System

September 15, 2026

To: Minato Manufacturing Inc.

From: Aoba Systems Inc.

## Summary

We propose to replace the order system and cut the manual entry work. The total cost is $2,200,000 including tax, and the new system is planned to go live on Thursday, April 1, 2027. The largest item, development, is $1,200,000.

## Cost

| Item | Amount |
| --- | --- |
| Requirements | $500,000 |
| Development | $1,200,000 |
| Migration and training | $300,000 |
| Subtotal | $2,000,000 |
| Sales tax (10%) | $200,000 |
| Total | $2,200,000 |

## Schedule

- Thursday, October 1, 2026: requirements start
- Tuesday, December 1, 2026: development starts
- Monday, March 1, 2027: migration and training start
- Thursday, April 1, 2027: the system goes live

## Validity

This proposal is valid from September 15, 2026 to December 15, 2026.
